objectives.text: Given a block diagram, DESCRIBE the operation of a typical voltage regulator.

enabling.text: STATE the purpose for voltage regulation equipment.
Given a block diagram of a typical voltage regulator, DESCRIBE the function of each of the following components:

passages.quote: The purpose of a voltage regulator is to maintain the output voltage of a generator at a desired value.
the output voltage of an AC generator varies with both changes in load (i.e., current) and changes in power factor.
The sensing circuit senses output voltage of the AC generator.
The reference circuit maintains a constant output for reference.
The comparison circuit electrically compares the reference voltage to the sensed voltage and provides an error signal.
takes the signal from the comparison circuit and amplifies the milliamp input to an amp output
The signal output circuit, which controls field excitation of the AC generator, increases or decreases field excitation to either raise or lower the AC output voltage.
It does this to prevent overshooting or undershooting of the desired voltage by slowing down the circuit response.

body.text: As load on an AC generator changes, the voltage tends to change, mainly because of the changing voltage drop across the armature winding.
The IR drop depends on the load change only. The IXL drop depends on the load change and also the power factor of the circuit.

checks.q: What two changes make the output voltage of an AC generator vary?
o: Changes in load and changes in power factor
Changes in frequency and rotor weight
Changes in brush size and slip
Changes in temperature and pole count
checks.x: The output voltage of an AC generator varies with both changes in load (current) and changes in power factor.

body.alt: Block diagram of a voltage regulator: sensing and reference circuits feed a comparison circuit, then an amplifier and signal output circuit to the generator field, with a feedback path.

body.text: Its signal is proportional to output voltage and goes to the comparison circuit.
This reference is the desired voltage output of the AC generator.
The feedback circuit takes some of the output of the signal output circuit and feeds it back to the amplification circuit.

checks.q: Which voltage regulator circuit controls the field excitation of the AC generator?
checks.x: The signal output circuit controls field excitation, increasing or decreasing it to raise or lower the AC output voltage.

checks.q: What does the feedback circuit prevent?
o: Overshooting or undershooting of the desired voltage
checks.x: The feedback circuit prevents overshooting or undershooting of the desired voltage by slowing down the circuit response.

checks.q: What does the reference circuit of a voltage regulator do?
o: Maintains a constant output for reference
checks.x: The reference circuit maintains a constant output for reference, which is the desired voltage output.

examples.title: Load increases
examples.problem: Generator load increases and output voltage drops. Follow the regulator's response.
steps: The sensing circuit senses the decrease and lowers its input to the comparison circuit.
The reference stays constant, so the comparison circuit develops a positive error signal.
The amplifier circuit amplifies it and sends it to the signal output circuit.
The signal output circuit increases field excitation.
examples.answer: Generated voltage increases to the desired output

examples.title: Load decreases
examples.problem: Generator load decreases and output voltage rises. What does the regulator do?
steps: The comparison circuit develops a negative error signal.
The signal output circuit decreases field excitation.
examples.answer: Generated voltage decreases to the desired output

facts.q: What does the comparison circuit of a voltage regulator produce?
facts.a: An error signal, from comparing the reference voltage to the sensed voltage.

facts.q: What does the sensing circuit of a voltage regulator do?
facts.a: It senses the output voltage of the AC generator.

facts.q: What does the amplification circuit of a voltage regulator do?
facts.a: It takes the signal from the comparison circuit and amplifies the milliamp input to an amp output.

summary.text: The purpose of a voltage regulator is to maintain the output voltage of a generator at a desired value.
A regulator has sensing, reference, comparison, amplification, signal output, and feedback circuits.
